# Production strip manifest (SECURITY-08). Read by tools/ci/check_prod_strip.py.
#
# Everything listed here must be absent from production builds: the API image (aip-api), and the
# web build (apps/web/dist, served by aip-web). The strip test fails if any entry is present.
# Format: one `<kind> <value>` per line; `#` starts a comment. Values contain no spaces.
#
#   forbidden    dotted module: dev tooling the blueprint says is stripped from production
#                (security module README). It must not import and no file for it may exist.
#   dev-module   dotted module: test-only or dev-only code (test runners, the scaffolding template,
#                the test-only `widgets` module). It must not import in a production image.
#   dev-glob     glob under the installed `aip` package: test files must not ship.
#   image-path   absolute path that must not exist in the API image (source checkouts, tooling).
#   route        URL path prefix no production app may mount (debug and test-only routes).
#   web-glob     glob under the web build output that must match nothing (source maps, tests).
#   web-marker   literal string no web build file may contain (dev-only runtime code).

# The five blueprint items (docs/blueprint/modules/security/README.md).
forbidden    aip.fixtures.admin             # admin fixtures
forbidden    aip.modules.architecture_map   # architecture map generator
forbidden    aip.modules.module_builder     # module builder
forbidden    aip.modules.pipelines          # pipeline designer
forbidden    aip.modules.compliance_dsl     # compliance DSL

dev-module   aip.modules._template          # scaffolding copied by tools/new_module.py
dev-module   aip.modules.widgets            # test-only module (AGENTS.md)
dev-module   tests                          # apps/api/tests
dev-module   pytest
dev-module   _pytest
dev-module   pytest_asyncio
dev-module   testcontainers
dev-module   hypothesis
dev-module   pypdf                          # test-only PDF reader
dev-module   ruff
dev-module   pyright
dev-module   importlinter

dev-glob     **/tests
dev-glob     **/test_*.py
dev-glob     **/*_test.py
dev-glob     **/conftest.py

image-path   /app/tools
image-path   /app/docs
image-path   /app/e2e
image-path   /app/apps/api/tests
image-path   /app/apps/web
image-path   /app/.git
image-path   /app/.env
image-path   /src

route        /api/v1/_debug
route        /_debug

web-glob     **/*.map
web-glob     **/*.test.*
web-glob     **/*.spec.*
web-glob     **/.env*

web-marker   sourceMappingURL=
web-marker   /@vite/client
web-marker   $RefreshReg$
web-marker   jsxDEV
web-marker   react-jsx-dev-runtime
web-marker   react-dom.development
web-marker   /_debug/
